concerns.text: T004's verification requires `code/utils/verify_pii_removal.py` to pass, but no task in T001–T010 creates that script (plan.md's T-031b described it; the consolidated re-plan dropped it). Dangling dependency means the FR-003/US-1 PII verification step cannot execute. Fold the script's creation into T004 or T009.

Spec edge case: 'partial data from dropouts is excluded from paired analyses, logging the dropout count.' T004 writes `dropout_flags.json`, but T005's analysis pipeline only applies the >30-min outlier exclusion; it never reads or applies dropout flags to exclude incomplete participants from paired analyses. The acceptance criterion is silently dropped.

Principle VI requires consent forms be 'kept only in the non-public data/consent/ directory AND referenced in the OSF reproducibility package.' T009 excludes `data/consent/` from the package (correct) but no task adds the required reference to consent handling in the package/README. Add the reference to T009's README deliverable.

Anonymization hashes participant IDs with a salt in `data/.salt` that is 'not committed.' Principle I (NON-NEGOTIABLE) requires every result reproducible on a fresh runner. If the salt is unavailable, ID-dependent grouping (participant random intercepts, cluster bootstrap) cannot be reproduced. Either derive IDs deterministically from pinned seeds (simulation makes this possible) or commit a salt that contains no PII.

FR-007 explicitly requires the package 'include a CI test procedure to verify this constraint' (≤6h/≤7GB on GitHub Actions). The re-plan removed all CI-side verification ('the platform supplies CI'), and T008's local `resource_monitor.py` measures the budget but is not a CI test procedure. Platform-CI ownership may excuse workflow authoring, but the spec-mandated CI-side budget verification needs an explicit equivalent (e.g., a runnable check the platform CI invokes) or a documented spec amendment — currently it is silently narrowed.

T010 cites 'docs/scope_reduction.md' as the justification for deferring real-subject recruitment, but no task creates that document and it is not among the provided artifacts. Either add a task to write it or remove the dangling reference so the scope-reduction rationale is auditable.
